annotations: Bucklodge Road (MD 117), Darnestown Road (MD 28) to Barnesville Road in Boyds. MDOT SHA counts it in one section with Barnesville Road, 'MD 28 TO MD 121', at station B2763, 0.10 mi west of MD 121 in Boyds: east of the junction where Barnesville Road (CO 237, its own count 3,860 a day, station S2012150730) and Slidell Road join. The section's 5,641 a day therefore includes Barnesville Road's traffic; Bucklodge itself carries roughly 5,641 - 3,860 = about 1,800 a day (our estimate, not a count). Rural two-lane, no posted speed, 21-23 ft wide, no shoulders (Montgomery Planning, Rustic Roads Functional Master Plan Volume II, adopted December 2023, which adds the whole road as a rustic road). Our rural rule (ODOT with half steps): 1,500-3,000 a day with no shoulder -> 3. The southern 2.6 mi (way 5976913) already rates 3 in the 2026-11-09 own-picks and is left as it is.
